name: Herbalist Cottage
defaultDescriptions: You step into the Herbalist Cottage. The fragrant aroma of dried herbs, crushed mint, and simmering alchemical tinctures greets your senses.
Shelves of glass vials, clay jars of medicinal salves, and bundles of wild foliage suspended from ceiling beams give this cozy shop a vibrant, rustic charm.

3,4: You stand near the wooden threshold of the cottage. An overhead brass bell chimes faintly as you move.
The front mat is woven from coarse thistle stalks to keep the muddy soil of the woods outside.
3,2: You stand before the main alchemical serving counter, where Herbalist Lyra carefully measures powders and brews tonics.
A glowing brass alembic bubbles rhythmically, distilling luminescent dew into delicate crystal bottles.

herb_drying_racks: Overhead wooden frames loaded with drying bunches of canis roots, sage, and pale blossoms slowly losing moisture.
potion_shelves: Carefully labeled bottles of health draughts, mana distillates, venom neutralizers, and aromatic mutagens.
alchemy_workbench: A smooth slate workbench equipped with copper scales, marble pestles, and glowing glassware used for delicate extractions.

triggers.label: Speak with Herbalist Lyra
triggers.tooltip: Browse remedies, purchase supplies, or ask about herbal gathering tasks.
triggers.description: Herbalist Lyra sets aside a sprig of fresh blossom, greeting you with a gentle, inquisitive smile.
